title: ר' יצחק בריה דרבה בב"ח

paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak, the son of Rabbah bar bar Ḥana, was Ḥoma's husband (see above, Issi bar Yitzḥak). He died, and Abaye married her. Rava said to him, 'Scholar [בר אוריא, literally “son of Torah”], let me tell you an excellent teaching that your father said in R. Elazar's name,' Sukkah (43b). In Yoma (77b), R. Yitzḥak bar bar Ḥana said: 'I saw Ze'iri going to Rav Ḥiyya bar Ashi, his student.' So too Bava Kamma (52a–b): R. Yitzḥak bar bar Ḥana said.
